name: io.github.amir20/dozzle
title: Dozzle
description: Read Docker container logs, search them, and check CPU and memory from a self-hosted Dozzle.

host.description: Your Dozzle address, with its base path if it has one (e.g. dozzle.example.com or example.com/dozzle). Start Dozzle with DOZZLE_ENABLE_MCP=true.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Only for clients without MCP OAuth when Dozzle uses simple auth: Bearer <token from POST /api/token>.
